attchmntText: Remsons Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "Press Release relating to announcement for Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026".
voiceSummary: Remsons Industries Limited approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2FY27 was Rs. 1,355 million, up 17% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 122 million with a 9% margin. Profit before tax was Rs. 63 million, and net profit after tax was Rs. 47 million. Diluted earnings per share were Rs. 1.36. The company secured a Rs. 3,000 million order from Stellantis N.V. for control cables. It also received a Rs. 300 million order for hood rods and a Rs. 120 million order for lighting design. Leadership changes include Mr. Rahul Desai as CEO and Mrs. Shivani Kejriwal as Additional Whole Time Director. The board approved exiting the joint venture with Aircom Remsons Automotive Private Limited. The company targets Rs. 9,000 to Rs. 10,000 million revenue by FY30.

attchmntText: Remsons Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Remsons Industries Limited filed an investor presentation titled Remsons Industries Limited Investor Presentation Q2 FY26-27 with the BSE and NSE on 7th November 2026. The presentation covers earnings for Q2 and H1 FY27. For H1 FY27, the company reported revenue of Rs 2,552 Mn, EBITDA of Rs 227 Mn with a margin of 9%, and Net PAT of Rs 76 Mn with a margin of 3%. Net debt to equity stood at 0.44 times as at March 2026. The board approved the exit from the joint venture Aircom Remsons Automotive Private Limited. Mr. Rahul Desai was appointed CEO effective 3rd August 2026, and Mrs. Shivani Kejriwal was appointed Whole Time Director effective 16th October 2026. The company secured a Rs 3,000 Mn order from Stellantis N.V. and a Rs 300 Mn order for Hood Rods.

attchmntText: Remsons Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Remsons Industries Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 7th November 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The results were prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards. Enclosed with the announcement are the financial results, Cash Flow Statement for the half year, Statement of Assets and Liabilities, and Limited Review Reports from Statutory Auditors. The Board meeting commenced at 11.30 A.M. and concluded at 12.45 P.M. The company operates in the Automotive Components segment. Mr. Rahul Prabhakar Desai was appointed as Chief Executive Officer with effect from 3rd August 2026. Mr. Rahul Kejriwal passed away on 6th October 2026.
